//: Single source of truth for identities. Third-party data (personal contacts, group members, communities) does NOT go in USER.md or MEMORY.md. Only the operator lives in USER.md. This file is readable from all workspaces.

personal_contacts.//: Personal contacts in DMs. NOT members of any WhatsApp group.

groups.//: Each WhatsApp group has its own members nested under it. Never mix members across groups.

communities.//: External communities/projects. Neither personal contacts nor group members.
